forbidden_inputs: cases/* events, values, outcomes, or diagnoses
scope.declaration: Concept-ID semantics and blind topology only; no case value, direction, final diagnosis, expected answer, or outcome was used.
scope.runtime_rule: Only rankable_observation enters likelihood. context_or_action_only cannot identify a branch. record_only/unmapped contributes exactly zero likelihood.

mapping_contract.value_direction_policy: All value_direction fields are null; a separate typed encoder projects actual values.
mapping_contract.derived_duplicate_policy: Collapse/schedule same_factor_group_ids jointly; derived flags/summaries never add independent likelihood.
mapping_contract.ambiguous_bundle_policy: Vague bundles remain record_only/unmapped until decomposed.
mapping_contract.action_policy: Only performed actions affect action memory; actions never supply disease identity.

same_factor_groups.rule: Raw value, abnormality flag, and trend are one creatinine stream.
